sky-beach.name: Sky Beach
sky-beach.building: The Standard, Bangkok Mahanakhon · King Power Mahanakhon
sky-beach.intro: Finish the day above Bangkok at Sky Beach. The outdoor bar at the top of Mahanakhon Tower pairs wide city views with cocktails and casual American food. Come with friends who enjoy DJ music for an evening of conversation, music and city lights. Arrive before sunset to see the skyline in daylight and stay as Bangkok lights up.

facts.children: All ages admitted · hotel’s official FAQ
facts.booking: Admission and seating first come, first served · use King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance

reasons.title: From the daytime skyline to city lights
reasons.text: Look out across Bangkok in every direction. Follow buildings and roads through the city by day, then watch the skyline fill with lights at night. It is a good place for photographs with friends or taking in the broad city views with family.

reasons.title: Cocktails and DJ music to finish the day
reasons.text: Enjoy cocktails and casual American food with DJ music. After a day of sightseeing, spend the evening talking with friends and looking out over Bangkok. Admission and seating are first come, first served; do not arrive assuming a seat has been reserved.

sky-beach.menu: Enjoy casual American food with cocktails. Choose drinks with your friends and take your time over the city views. Browse the menu through the official information below.

access.instructions: Leave BTS Silom Line Chong Nonsi through Exit 3 and walk towards King Power Mahanakhon. Enter the main entrance and follow Sky Beach admission instructions.

sky-beach.recommended: For friends who enjoy DJ music and wide city views, or family wanting to see Bangkok from above.
sky-beach.bestTime: Arrive before sunset for the city and sky in daylight, then stay to see Bangkok filled with lights.
faq: Who would enjoy a visit?

Come with friends who enjoy DJ music and broad city views, or family wanting to see Bangkok from above. Look across the city in every direction: follow the buildings and roads by day, then watch the skyline fill with lights at night. Enjoy photographs with friends or exploring the view with family.
Can children visit?
Yes, families can visit without an age restriction and enjoy the city views together. Admission and seating are first come, first served.
Can I visit late in the evening?
It opens daily from 10:00 to midnight, with last admission at 23:00. A late visit is possible, but arrive before the final entry time if you want to enjoy the views and drinks at an unhurried pace.
Which entrance should I use?
Use the main entrance of King Power Mahanakhon. From BTS Chong Nonsi Exit 3, walk towards Mahanakhon, then follow Sky Beach admission signs inside.
sky-beach.entrance: Enter through King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. If driving, you can use Mahanakhon Cube parking.
sky-beach.reservation: Admission and seating are first come, first served. Choose your companions and visiting time, then follow the admission instructions on site.

hongs-sky-bar.building: InterContinental Chiang Mai The Mae Ping · rooftop
hongs-sky-bar.intro: For an evening above Chiang Mai, visit HONG’s Sky Bar. From the outdoor terrace, look towards Doi Suthep and the city while enjoying cocktails and small sharing dishes. Come before sunset with a partner or friends, settle into conversation, and watch the mountain backdrop give way to the city lights.

reasons.title: From Doi Suthep at sunset to the city lights
reasons.text: Arrive before sunset if you want to see Doi Suthep. Talk with your companions while looking towards the mountain and city, then enjoy the lights after dark. After a busy sightseeing day, take the evening slowly and see another side of Chiang Mai.

reasons.title: Cocktails with Chinese sharing dishes
reasons.text: Pair cocktails made with Thai honey, lemongrass and Chiang Mai tea with Chinese dishes to share. It suits friends or couples wanting a drink and several dishes between them. As an outdoor bar, it may close in rain or bad weather; keep another evening plan in mind if rain is forecast.

hongs-sky-bar.recommended: For cocktails and evening views with friends or a partner. Look towards Doi Suthep and stay for the city lights, with time to talk after sightseeing.
hongs-sky-bar.bestTime: Arrive before sunset and take your time if you want both Doi Suthep and the illuminated city.
faq: Who would enjoy HONG’s?
Come with friends or a partner for cocktails and Chiang Mai’s evening views. You can look towards Doi Suthep and stay as the city lights appear, making it a relaxed place to talk after sightseeing.
When can I see both the mountain and night views?
Arrive before sunset. See Doi Suthep and the city in daylight, then enjoy the lights after dark. Allow time for cocktails and food rather than leaving straight after seeing the view.
What happens if I am late for my reservation?
Your booking may be cancelled if you arrive 15 minutes late. Leave enough time for sightseeing and travel so you can start the evening without rushing.
Can I visit in the rain?
The bar may close in rain or poor weather. Clear conditions let you enjoy the outdoor mountain and city views; check whether it is operating before setting out on a rainy day.

baba-nest.name: Baba Nest
baba-nest.intro: For a long look at Phuket’s sea at sunset, book Baba Nest. Beyond an infinity pool surrounding the open deck at Sri Panwa, the Andaman Sea and islands spread out below. It suits an anniversary with your partner or cocktails with friends. This reservation-only bar opens 17:00–20:00, so leave the evening free to enjoy sunset rather than squeezing it between other outings.

facts.minimumSpend: Hotel guests 1,500 baht net per person · non-resident guests 3,000 baht net per person; required to confirm the reservation
facts.booking: Advance reservation required · seats held 15 minutes after the booked time · call ahead if delayed
facts.rain: Closes in rain · non-resident minimum spend can transfer to Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food in bad weather

reasons.title: An evening looking across the pool and sea
reasons.text: Enjoy the view where the infinity pool around the deck seems to meet the sea beyond. Look out across nearby islands and Phuket’s southeastern peninsula. Share cocktails with your companions as the sky changes colour for an evening to remember.

reasons.title: Take your time over cocktails and tapas
reasons.text: Pair cocktails, wine or champagne with Mexican tapas. Choose a day when you have time for drinks and views rather than a rushed dinner. Browse the menu together and spend time looking out to sea.

reasons.title: Plan around reservations and weather
reasons.text: Advance reservations and a minimum spend apply. Opening hours 17:00–20:00 make this a sunset visit rather than a late-night stop. Rain closes the bar, so read the booking conditions and consider the forecast when choosing your date.

baba-nest.menu: Cocktails, wine and champagne with Mexican tapas.

access.name: Sri Panwa Phuket
access.instructions: Search “Sri Panwa Phuket” in Grab or Bolt. On arrival, ask staff for the way to Baba Nest. Arrange your return transport too if staying for the evening.

baba-nest.recommended: For wide sunset views across the sea and islands, or an anniversary evening.
baba-nest.bestTime: Open 17:00–20:00. Reserve for an evening enjoying the sea and sky around sunset.
faq: Do I need a reservation?

Yes. Choose your companions and date, then reserve in advance. Seats are held for 15 minutes after the booked time, so finish other outings with time to spare. Contact the venue beforehand if you will be late.
What is the minimum spend?

It is 1,500 baht net per hotel guest and 3,000 baht net per non-resident guest. This is required to confirm the booking, so include it in your cocktail and tapas budget. Read the payment conditions rather than treating it as a separate admission fee.
What happens if it rains?

Baba Nest closes in rain. In bad weather, non-resident guests’ minimum spend can be transferred for use at Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food. Read this condition before booking if sea views and sunset are the reason for your visit.
Can I visit late at night?
It opens daily 17:00–20:00. Plan for sunset views rather than late-night drinks, leaving enough time to settle in before the sun goes down.
baba-nest.budget: Minimum spend is 1,500 baht net per hotel guest or 3,000 baht net per non-resident guest. Read the payment conditions when booking; it is not a separate admission fee.

star-silavadee.name: STAR by Silavadee
star-silavadee.intro: For an evening looking out to sea on Koh Samui, visit STAR. From the rooftop of Silavadee Pool Spa Resort, enjoy Western dishes and cocktails above Lamai Bay. Four sunken tables set within the infinity pool are a distinctive seating option. Come for dinner with a partner or drinks and travel stories with friends. Start early for the sea views and stay for an unhurried meal together.

facts.address: 208/66 Moo 4, Maret, Koh Samui 84310, Thailand
facts.booking: Use Make a Reservation on the official venue page

reasons.title: Start the evening above Lamai Bay
reasons.text: Look down over Lamai Bay from the resort rooftop. Arrive early in the evening if you want to see the sea in daylight. Share cocktails or wine and continue into dinner, leaving time to enjoy the view together.

reasons.title: Four tables set down into the pool
reasons.text: There are four sunken tables within the infinity pool. They suit couples looking for distinctive seating with a sea view. Lounge beds and bar stools are also available; ask about your preferred seats when reserving.

star-silavadee.menu: Western dinner dishes with cocktails and wine. Cocktails include Espresso Martini, Lychee Martini and Tom Yum Siam.
star-silavadee.seating: Four sunken tables within the pool, regular dining seats, lounge beds and bar stools; 42 seats in total. Ask about your preferred seating when reserving.
star-silavadee.bestTime: Opens 17:30. Arrive early for the sea in daylight and continue into dinner. Leave time for a cocktail above Lamai Bay before eating.

star-silavadee.recommended: For dinner above the sea with a partner or cocktails and travel stories with friends. Mention preferred seating when you reserve.
faq: Who would enjoy STAR?
Come with a partner for dinner above the sea or friends for cocktails and travel stories. Choose a day when you want Lamai Bay’s scenery alongside the meal.
Can I sit at a table in the pool?
There are four sunken tables within the pool, as well as regular dining seats, lounge beds and bar stools. Ask about your preferred seating when reserving. Total capacity is 42 seats.
When should I come for the sea view and dinner?
It opens 17:30. Arrive early, start with a cocktail and continue to dinner if you want the sea in daylight. The kitchen closes 22:30, so allow for meal time when booking a late visit.
How do I book?
Use Make a Reservation on the official venue page. Choose your date, companions and time, and ask about a pool table or other preferred seating when booking.
What should I wear?

The official booking guidance specifies smart casual. Think of neat clothes for an evening out: a collared shirt and long trousers for men or a dress or blouse for women are examples to help you prepare, not additional gender-specific requirements.

horizon-pattaya.name: Horizon Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
horizon-pattaya.intro: For dinner with views across Pattaya Bay, visit Horizon on the 34th floor of Hilton Pattaya. Enjoy a rooftop meal and cocktails with a partner for an anniversary or parents you would like to treat to an evening out. Arrive around sunset and take your time as the colours of the sea and sky change and lights appear along the coast.

facts.booking: Use Horizon’s Book a Table on Hilton’s official Dining page

reasons.title: Finish a beach day on the 34th floor
reasons.text: See the beach you walked along during the day from above. The outdoor terrace opens onto broad Pattaya Bay views, with lights following the coastline after dark. Share a cocktail and talk about the places you explored together.

reasons.title: Stay for dinner with the view
reasons.text: Dishes include a seafood tower, tomahawk steak and lamb shank. With an indoor dining room and outdoor terrace, it suits an evening when you want dinner with a view. For an anniversary or meal with parents, leave enough time so you do not have to rush elsewhere afterwards.

reasons.title: DJ music with the evening view
reasons.text: Live DJ music accompanies the evening. It suits couples or friends wanting music and views with dinner rather than only quiet conversation. If considering the terrace, look at indoor seating too in case of heat or rain.

horizon-pattaya.seating: Indoor dining and an outdoor terrace. Ask about sea-facing terrace seating when reserving.

Come with a partner or parents for dinner with night views. The 34th floor of Hilton Pattaya overlooks the sea and city, making it a good choice for an evening devoted to a special meal.
When are the views best?
Arrive around sunset to watch the sea and sky change colour. Stay for dinner to see the city lights come on. Mention terrace seating when reserving if that is your preference.
What can I eat?
Options include a seafood tower, Australian Angus tomahawk steak, lamb shank and snow fish with miso sauce. Browse the menu together and choose whether to have dinner or focus on cocktails and views.

mahanakhon-skywalk.intro: See Bangkok in every direction at Mahanakhon SkyWalk. Explore the indoor observation deck on the 74th floor and outdoor deck on the 78th, then look down through the glass floor 310m above the city. A viewing point at 314m is another feature. Come with friends who enjoy landscape photography or family wanting to see Bangkok from above. Leave time to enjoy the different indoor and outdoor views.

facts.booking: Select a ticket for your date, time slot and age on the official ticket page.

reasons.title: Bangkok from indoors and outdoors
reasons.text: See Bangkok from the 74th floor indoor deck and 78th floor outdoor deck. Moving between the spaces gives you different ways to enjoy the same city. Explore the skyline with family or friends.

reasons.title: A glass floor above the city
reasons.text: The glass floor at 310m is a distinctive experience here. Look below with companions who enjoy heights. If the height feels uncomfortable, focus on the city views instead of forcing yourself onto the glass.

mahanakhon-skywalk.entrance: Show your ticket at the ground-floor main entrance and ticket counter, pass the photo area and digital corridor, then take the lift to the 74th floor. The 75th floor is the boarding area for the glass lift to the upper level.
mahanakhon-skywalk.recommended: For family or friends who enjoy city views and photographs of Bangkok from above. If the glass floor feels uncomfortable, choose the viewing experience that suits each person.

faq: Is this the same venue as Sky Beach bar?

Which ticket should I choose?
Use the official ticket page to select the date, time slot and age category. Child tickets are for ages 8–12, so choose according to your child’s age.
How do I get there by rail?
From BTS Silom Line Chong Nonsi Exit 3, go to King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. Follow the ground-floor ticket counter and visitor lift instructions.
Which floors can I visit?
The 74th floor indoor observation deck and 78th floor outdoor deck. Leave time for both to enjoy the skyline from different spaces.

reasons.title: The 77th floor and 84th floor revolving deck
reasons.text: Explore both viewing floors and look across central Bangkok. The revolving deck on the 84th floor is a distinctive feature. Take time to find different parts of the city together.

reasons.title: Add a view to a Pratunam shopping day
reasons.text: If you plan to shop around Pratunam, include the observation decks on the same day. Talk about your finds with friends and finish by looking across the city.

baiyoke-observatory.recommended: For friends shopping around Pratunam or companions who enjoy central-city views. Add an observation-deck visit to your shopping day.

doi-suthep-viewpoint.english: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep Viewpoint
doi-suthep-viewpoint.building: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep · viewpoint within the temple grounds
doi-suthep-viewpoint.intro: Combine a mountain temple with views over Chiang Mai at Doi Suthep. Explore the golden pagoda and Lanna architecture, then look down over the city from the terrace. Walk slowly with parents or friends interested in temples, take photographs and pause over the view.

facts.address: Huai Kaeo Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai

reasons.title: Explore the golden pagoda, then look over the city
reasons.text: After admiring the golden pagoda and Lanna architecture, walk to the terrace. Chiang Mai spread below gives you a different view from exploring its streets. Enjoy both temple architecture and city scenery with interested companions.

reasons.title: Climb beside the naga sculptures
reasons.text: The 306 steps with naga sculptures along both sides are part of the visit. Walk up slowly and look at the carvings together. A cable car is an alternative if the stairs are difficult. With parents or children, choose the ascent that suits their stamina.

doi-suthep-viewpoint.entrance: Climb the 306 steps beside the naga sculptures or use the cable car. If you want to see the carvings, walk up slowly. Follow signs inside the temple towards the viewpoint.
doi-suthep-viewpoint.recommended: For parents or friends who enjoy temple architecture and city scenery. Explore the golden pagoda, then pause over Chiang Mai from the terrace. Plan this as a temple visit; it is not a bar where you order drinks.

access.name: Rod Daeng
access.instructions: Before boarding a red songthaew, agree that it goes to Doi Suthep temple, whether it is one-way or return, and the total fare. With parents or children, arrange the return too before setting out. At the temple entrance, take the stairs or cable car up.

faq: Who would enjoy Doi Suthep?

Visit with parents or friends who enjoy temple architecture and city views. Explore the golden pagoda, then pause on the terrace above Chiang Mai. This is a viewpoint within a temple, so plan a temple visit rather than a bar outing.
Do I have to climb the stairs?

No, a cable car is also available. Choose the 306 steps for the naga sculptures or the cable car if walking uphill is difficult for your companions. Explore the architecture as you make your way to the terrace.
How do I get there by songthaew?

You can take a red songthaew from Chiang Mai to Doi Suthep temple. Before boarding, agree that it goes to the temple, whether the journey is one-way or return, and the total fare. Plan the return as well so you can continue your day comfortably after enjoying the view.
Is the map pin the viewing terrace?
The map shows the temple complex. On arrival, take the stairs or cable car up and follow local signs to the viewing terrace, exploring the temple architecture along the way.

Come with adult friends who have seen The Hangover Part II or a partner who enjoys night views for an evening of cocktails. Look across the Chao Phraya River and central Bangkok from the outdoor bar beside the golden dome. Share travel stories with friends or enjoy the lights with a partner.
Do I need a reservation?
No. Sky Bar is walk-in only. Arrange your evening and visit without a booking. One drink per person is required, so plan to enjoy a drink with the view.
Can children visit?

What should I wear?

faq: Who is Sirocco good for?

Choose it for an anniversary with your partner or a special dinner for your parents. Dining under the golden dome with Bangkok’s night views makes time together the focus of the evening. Pick a day when you will not have to hurry elsewhere after dinner.
When should I visit for jazz?

Choose Tuesday–Sunday for live jazz. Listen while dining above the city lights. Mondays have background music instead. Ask the playing times when booking to choose a meal time that includes the performance.
Can I bring children?

Yes. There is no minimum age, so families with young children can dine together. Dress children neatly rather than in sportswear or flip-flops. Other bars in the same building have their own age rules if you plan to visit them afterwards.
What should I wear?

Think of clothes for a smart evening dinner. A shirt or polo with neat trousers and loafers, or a dress or blouse with a skirt or trousers, are useful examples. Neat shorts and dressy sandals are allowed; a suit or high heels are not compulsory. Sportswear, swimwear and flip-flops are prohibited, as are men’s sleeveless tops.
How do reservations and cancellations work?

Choose your date and companions, then use the official booking link above to select a time. The deposit is deducted from the meal and the reservation is confirmed after payment is received. Ordinary bookings can be cancelled or changed free of charge until 72 hours before the visit. Later changes, cancellations and no-shows lose the deposit. Special events and group reservations have different refund terms.
Can I have dinner late at night?

Yes, but opening until 00:30 does not mean every dish can be ordered until then. Set menus close at 23:00, à la carte at 23:30 and snacks at midnight. For an unhurried course meal with the night view, book an earlier evening time rather than arriving very late.
Can I bring luggage or large shopping bags?

No. Large bags, luggage and shopping bags cannot be brought in, and there is no storage. Enjoy sightseeing or shopping by day, then leave bags and change at your accommodation before coming to Sirocco. If you have checked out, arrange somewhere to store your bags during dinner first.
